$comment: Generated by authoring/canon-tools/build_catalog.py. Machine twin of CATALOG.md. Read useWhen to choose; filter on the closed vocabularies.

templates.name: A long argument on tinted ground, beside its model
templates.useWhen: A position needing three or four hundred words, with the model it rests on visible alongside.

templates.name: One sentence, centred, over a dot field
templates.useWhen: One sentence marking the turn between two arguments. A breath, not a point.

templates.name: Five tensions, each placed on its line
templates.useWhen: Tensions rather than choices — and the evidence to say WHERE something sits between two poles.

templates.name: A long list shown as a complete set
templates.useWhen: Ten to sixteen offerings have to be seen as a whole, where the breadth is the point rather than any one item.

templates.name: Framing column beside a grid of instances
templates.useWhen: One principle, then four to six named instances of it — and the principle needs more room than any instance.

templates.name: Numbered method steps across a ground change
templates.useWhen: Three or four named stages, each needing a sentence of substance rather than a label.

templates.name: Four stages, each with its receipts
templates.useWhen: Four stages of a transformation, each with a screenshot of what was built and what changed.

templates.name: Three levels of a problem, in clients' own words
templates.useWhen: The same problem appears at three levels of maturity, and each level has a client quote that proves it.

templates.name: Phases side by side, with today's one marked
templates.useWhen: Three or four phases with long activity lists, and it matters which phase the client is in now.

templates.name: Three eras of work, each owning a panel
templates.useWhen: Work runs in three named phases with different characters, and each deserves the weight of a full-height panel.

templates.name: Five-stage method with substance under each stage
templates.useWhen: A method of four or five stages where each stage has real activities and deliverables to name.

templates.name: Several inputs converging on a few scores
templates.useWhen: Three or four scores on a common scale, shown as derived from named inputs rather than asserted.

templates.name: Claim held up by five numbers across a rule
templates.useWhen: A claim needing five pieces of quantitative proof, where the claim is what the room should leave with.

templates.name: Sorted into nine bands, not scored on a line
templates.useWhen: Fifteen to twenty-five candidates where the scoring is a judgement and the bands are what gets argued about.

templates.name: Everything scored on two axes at once
templates.useWhen: Ten to thirty-five candidates to prioritise, where relative position matters more than which box they fall in.

templates.name: Four disciplines contained in one system
templates.useWhen: Four capabilities that live INSIDE one system rather than beside each other, with prose to land the claim.

templates.name: A capability architecture, read top to bottom
templates.useWhen: An offer with stacked layers, where one layer is plainly where all the substance lives.

templates.name: Front stage and backstage, cut by one line
templates.useWhen: What the client sees and what runs underneath, shown as one system rather than two.

templates.name: A taxonomy that divides the whole space
templates.useWhen: Three to five named classes that between them exhaust a space.

templates.name: A visual, and what to notice in it
templates.useWhen: A screenshot, diagram or dashboard has to be EXPLAINED — the audience needs telling what to look at and in what order.

templates.name: Half-bleed image beside a connected sequence
templates.useWhen: Three to five named moves in order, where the subject deserves a full-height image.

templates.name: Method, three cases, and what it was worth
templates.useWhen: A repeatable process produced three concrete examples with a measurable outcome, and the point is that the cases came from the process.

templates.name: Partner wall organised by category
templates.useWhen: A partner roster where which category a logo sits in matters as much as its being there.

templates.name: Partner credentials compared side by side
templates.useWhen: Two or three partnerships, each with its own proof and client roster, all of them strong.

templates.name: Who is in the room
templates.useWhen: Four to six people placed by role and location at the top of a meeting. Not biographies.
